transcript.text: Hi there! Thanks for calling. I'm here to help you get an auto insurance quote filled out today. Let me get started on that for you right away.
Hi! To get started on your auto insurance quote, I'll need a few details from you. Can you give me your full name and your date of birth in year-month-day format?
Hi there! I'm looking to get a quote for auto insurance on my car. Can you help me with that?

Absolutely, I can help you with that! I've got the form ready to go. To get started, could you please give me your full name and your date of birth? I'll need it in year-month-day format, like 1990-03-15.
Sure! My name is Sarah Mitchell and my date of birth is 1989-04-12.
Perfect! I've got that down — Sarah Mitchell, born April 12th, 1989. Let me get that into the form for you.
Great, thanks! What other information do you need from me?
Great! Let me get your information into the system now and we'll move through the rest of the details from there.
Perfect! Now I just need a couple more contact details to move forward. Can you give me your email address and phone number?
Sure! My email is sarah.mitchell89@gmail.com and my phone number is 415-555-0173.
Wonderful! I've got your email and phone number. Now I'll need a few more details — can you give me your home address?
Yeah, I live at 2847 Fillmore Street in San Francisco, zip code 94123.
Perfect, I've got that address down. Now let me ask you about your vehicle — what's the make, model, and year of the car you're looking to insure?
It's a 2021 Toyota RAV4.
Great, a 2021 Toyota RAV4 — I've got that down. One more thing: have you had any insurance claims in the last 5 years?
Okay, so I've got your vehicle — a 2021 Toyota RAV4. Just one more quick question: have you had any insurance claims in the last 5 years?
Nope, I haven't had any claims in the last five years. I'm actually looking for full coverage on this vehicle.
Perfect! So no prior claims, and you'd like full coverage — I've got that noted down. Let me get everything submitted for you right now.
Perfect! So no prior claims and full coverage — that's all noted. Let me get everything submitted for you right now.

Great! Just to confirm everything before I submit your quote: Sarah Mitchell, born April 12th, 1989, email sarah.mitchell89@gmail.com, phone 415-555-0173, address 2847 Fillmore Street in San Francisco, zip 94123, your 2021 Toyota RAV4 with full coverage, and no prior claims in the last five years. Does everything look correct, and should I go ahead and submit this?
Yes, that all sounds perfect! Go ahead and submit it please.
Perfect! I'm submitting your quote right now.
Great! How long does it usually take to hear back about the quote?
You should hear back within 24 hours, and we'll send the quote details to your email at sarah.mitchell89@gmail.com. Your form is being submitted right now, so you're all set!

Excellent news! Your auto insurance quote has been submitted successfully. Your reference number is Q-1 — you can use that if you need to follow up on your quote. You should expect to hear back within 24 hours at sarah.mitchell89@gmail.com.
